title: Copied centers with fixed local bases for conditional κ = 3.886224e-5
body:
Under the retained analytic and fixed finite-alphabet multitape hypotheses,

**T(n) = O(n (log n)^(1 − κ)), with κ = 242889/6250000000 = 3.886224 × 10⁻⁵.**

This composes icekylinx's copied retained-center schedule (#36, `11817ccacb564bb7f98789c20dc11d3fece207e3`) with the original-envelope, fixed-`I+J` method from #35 (`9c345a2a11e5f4f3649f7c68214bf9a2a0a3fe9c`) on the actual #36 base-two bit graphs at **(25,23)**. It improves #36 by **1.0540111%**, and the latest #37 (`2f7578affce416ad4b6c41f3438ebb734f66a899`, κ = 3.850771033e-5) by **0.9206719%**. These comparisons concern conditional exponent savings, not measured runtime.

### Construction and exact result

Both local bases are fixed to `I+J`, with the original envelope labels and original oriented carrier matching. Complete local transition profiles replace the generic local profiles. The conservative data profile is **26 singletons + [21,481]**; the generic second 15-block is not assumed to survive. All 23 actual controlled permutations and both 47-edge incidence trees establish compatibility in the same physical order.

The copied-center transform is retained and paid in both invocation orientations. Only each retained total's full-rank cleanup is replaced by its rank-one complement. All **4,073,300 paid endpoint-copy corrections**, auxiliary exteriors, complete role volumes, controls, spectators, arbitrary scratch restoration and sequential fixed-tape workspace remain. Total physical rank is **108,202,762,275 = Wm − N + L**.

The exact bit saving is `19432631/500000000000 = 3.8865262e-5`. The inherited #36 complex saving is `717/10^7`; its complete moment is replayed. The semantic envelope retains its literal scalar gate charge, `C1=1` and product row stock `p^2000`. Both exact moments, **47 strict assembly conditions** and all **seven margins** pass. The bit moment gap exceeds `6.3667e-15`, and the final absorption gap exceeds `5.1804e-14`.

### Validation before filing

- Rebuilt both actual scalar DAGs, every original label inclusion, the original oriented matching and every local transition profile at h=23 and h=25; complete records match the checked-in fixtures.
- Dimension-specific minor bounds with Lucas–Lehmer-certified primes: rank-two corrections use one prime; source growth and core changes use three primes. Exact zeros are certified by CRT bounds, not sampled ranks.
- Exact certificate, complete physical accounting, both moments, actual permutations/trees and all assembly inequalities pass. Independent parent review reconstructed the physical child list and evaluated a separate rational moment enclosure.
- Four negative controls pass: missing tree edge, omitted copied schedule, omitted data block and the next final-κ grid point. The next sufficient bit-moment enclosure grid point also fails; this does not establish global optimality.
- Generated proof patch applies to pinned #36; Python syntax and diff whitespace checks pass. No PDF or large binary is included.

**Validation complete:** the full inherited `make verify` rerun passed at `cc794077f6c103e24ec0939be765cd1521239aab`: **170 regression tests and 19 proof-patch checks**, including both selected producer rebuilds. Regenerated certificate data are unchanged; one inherited JSON key-order difference was checked for parsed equality and its committed serialization retained. The detailed receipt is `research/copied-fixed-basis/validation.json`. The finite checks support the written conditional proof; no formal verification or external mathematical acceptance is claimed.

Start with the [proof and reproduction guide](https://github.com/DominikScholz/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/copied-fixed-basis/research/copied-fixed-basis/README.md), [proof](https://github.com/DominikScholz/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/copied-fixed-basis/notes/copied-fixed-basis.tex), and [exact certificate](https://github.com/DominikScholz/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/copied-fixed-basis/research/copied-fixed-basis/certificate.json). Run `make copied-fixed-check`, `make copied-fixed-producer`, and `make verify`. The original analytic, routing, recovery, prime-existence, constructive setup and eventual-threshold hypotheses remain explicit.
